articles.summary: AI is transforming scientific research by automating the slowest parts of discovery: collecting, labeling, and analyzing data. At the Field Museum, researchers used vision AI to digitize 13,500 insect specimens in weeks, showing that with the right tools, decades of work can happen in days.
articles.title: Scientific Research AI: Unlocking Visual Data
